newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Ta-Jung to build NT$1.15 bln soyoil plant.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Ta-Jung to build NT$1.15 bln soyoil plant.

text.p: Taiwan soyoil group Ta-Jung plans to invest NT$1.15 billion (US$41.8 million) to build a soybean crushing plant by late 1998, grain traders said.
Ta-Jung's plant would have daily capacity of 3,500 tonnes, up from the group members' current 500 tonnes' capacity.
Ta-Jung is a joint venture of Sino Japan Feed Corp, Great Wall Enterprise and other smaller oilseed crushers.
State-run Taiwan Sugar Corp was considering whether to join the Ta-Jung group, traders said.
Taiwan imported 2.4 million tonnes of soybeans in 1996 for its huge food processing industry. Most of the grain came from the United States.
